title: Workout (get_workout_by_id)
description:
Returned by garminconnect's get_workout_by_id(workout_id) — confirmed 2026-08-07 to be the same shape as upload_workout's response (see CLAUDE.md). Called by sync_pending_workouts only when it recovers an earlier timed-out upload from the library, to write the workout_detail measurement the upload response would have supplied. Only the fields _write_workout_detail reads are listed.

Verified against: 2026-10-17 (probe workout, then deleted). A deleted workout 404s. Additional fields beyond what's listed here may exist and are tolerated (additionalProperties: true).
